snippet.title: Soul's Remnant - 2023 Trailer
snippet.description:
Soul's Remnant is a 2D platformer MMORPG that features social and player-driven gameplay where you can build your character however you want, and learn any skill you want in it's classless skill system! Explore its mysterious world with your friends, or make some friends along the way! Just be careful about adventuring too far out at night~

Join our Discord to play Soul's Remant for free on December 22nd! https://discord.gg/soulsremnant

Support Soul's Remnant on Patreon and get fun in-game rewards!
https://patreon.com/chaomoon

Learn more about the game on my website: https://soulsremnant.com/

Trailer made by Rajah
